title: Remove duplicate SCHC_BITMAP_MASK definition from SCHC implementation
description: Both lichen/subsys/schc/include/schc/schc.h and lichen/subsys/schc/schc.c define SCHC_BITMAP_MASK. Strict host and pinned Zephyr v3.7 RAK4631 builds use -Werror and fail schc.c with macro redefined. Keep one canonical definition with identical 63-bit semantics and preserve all fragmentation tests/vectors. Acceptance: focused host lichen/tests/schc passes and the pinned RAK4631 build compiles schc.c without macro-redefinition diagnostics.
notes:
Removed the private schc.c duplicate, leaving the public schc.h definition as the single authority: ((UINT64_C(1) << 63U) - 1U), which shifts a 64-bit unsigned value by 63 and avoids width/UB ambiguity. Local AppleClang -std=c23 strict object compile passed and repository search finds exactly one definition. The existing standalone host test now compiles generic schc.c but has an unrelated stale link source list; filed related project-LICHEN-worker6-h45a. Pinned Zephyr v3.7 RAK4631 targeted schc.c object compiled successfully under GCC 12 with -std=c2x and full hardening, and isolation verify passed. Pinned schc_generic configuration succeeded but canonical vector generation rejects current format_version 2 due stale version-1 gate; filed related project-LICHEN-worker6-1mb9. sync twice completed.
Approved workstation stop completed and confirmed stopped with Project=LICHEN tag.
close_reason: Single authoritative 63-bit-safe bitmap mask retained in public header; strict host object and pinned RAK4631 schc.c compilation pass. Follow-up test-harness drift filed separately.
